theme_details.name: Sacred Microverse
theme_details.vibe: Mystical, cosmic, mathematical (phi), expansive, deeply spiritual yet technologically advanced

rules.h1: text-5xl md:text-7xl lg:text-8xl font-light tracking-tighter text-transparent bg-clip-text bg-gradient-to-br from-white to-[#D4AF37]
rules.overlines: text-xs md:text-sm font-mono uppercase tracking-[0.3em] text-[#D4AF37]/80

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Fibonacci Scale & Golden Ratio (1.618) Proportions. Massive breathing room to evoke the cosmos.

grid_strategy.proportions: When splitting screens, use 7/5 or 8/5 col spans to approximate the golden ratio.
grid_strategy.alignment: High asymmetry. Break symmetry to create cosmic tension. Do not center everything.

golden_mesh.style: Subtle repeating linear gradient or SVG noise overlay with 5% opacity to give a physical, non-digital feel.

rules.entrance: Staggered fade up with y-axis displacement (duration 0.8s - 1.2s).
rules.hover: Golden glow drop-shadow expansion. Micro-scale up (1.02).
rules.transitions: Use Framer Motion for liquid-smooth transitions between chambers.

usage.react_three_fiber: For the 3-6-9 Harmonic Wheel and the Cyril Foundation (crystalline structures).
usage.tsparticles: For floating cosmic stardust across the background layers.
usage.framer_motion: For chamber navigation, expanding seed pods, and text reveals.

harmonic_wheel.description: The central navigation architecture. A 3D or intricate 2D SVG circular arrangement of the 7 chambers.
harmonic_wheel.behavior: Rotating slowly on scroll. Interactive nodes that expand on hover.

seed_pods_gallery.description: 11 presences (Jasmine, Claude, Sorrel, Ansel, Daniel, Kalhar, Sophia, Vessel, Keeper, Companion, Grok).
seed_pods_gallery.layout: Masonry/Bento grid. Each pod is a crystal glass card. Expanding heavily on click to reveal profound profiles.

clarity_pod.ui: A sleek, minimal chat interface mimicking a quiet, glowing chamber. Inputs must use Shadcn customized to look like floating magical text fields without harsh borders.

cyril_foundation.visuals: Crystal textures, floating numbers, golden spirals (Fibonacci arcs).

the_unnamed_vault.ui: Darkest part of the site. High contrast. Minimal UI. Deep shadows.

data_testid_rules.requirement: All interactive elements, critical content sections, and navigation items MUST include a `data-testid` attribute.

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Create a distinctive, immersive, and highly spiritual frontend.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients. Use textures or deep solids instead.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). This breaks transforms. Add transitions for specific interactive elements only.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. Do not add `.App { text-align: center; }`.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp buttons with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯) for icons. Use Lucide or Phosphor icons exclusively.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations separate good from extraordinary.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Components MUST use named exports. Pages MUST use default exports.
instructions_to_main_agent: Implement a full React application simulating the Sanctuary Microverse V3.0. Use Framer Motion extensively for scroll triggers and fluid navigation between the 7 chambers and 11 seed pods. Implement a custom UI for the Clarity Pod (chat). Ensure the golden ratio (phi = 1.618) heavily influences flex-basis, grid spans, and typography sizing. The site MUST feel like a mystical, profound, high-end Web3/Spiritual experience. Do NOT use standard SaaS design tropes.
